cost_estimate_seconds.basis: four-rank 128^2 t=1.2 anchor 20.46s and 256^2 t=1.2 pilot 173.37s; cubic-in-N, linear-in-t sensitivity estimate
cost_estimate_seconds.limitations: Observed scaling was derived at eta=0.001 only; other eta may change timestep count and crossing time. Total forecast excludes reviewer latency and analysis overhead; retain about 180 seconds for independent review. Missing flux windows are censored.

resolution_policy: minimum 4 nominal Sweet-Parker widths per L and >=4 measured central-current FWHM cells during the flux window; refined family targets >=6 nominal cells. This minimum is a prospectively justified, method-reviewed budget adjustment; failures remain ineligible.
decision: Fit each resolution family separately only with at least three numerically valid, resolved, full-window, pre-plasmoid cases. OLS(log normalized R, log nominal S_eta); two-sided 95% Student-t slope interval with n-2 degrees of freedom. Expand the interval to the envelope of fits using both flux-path rate endpoints. Reject the allowed band only if this full interval is disjoint from [-0.60,-0.40]. Report overlap, too few eligible cases, or discordant families as inconclusive. No continuous-domain or universal claim follows from these finite samples.
